limits: This panel addresses aggregate failure-frequency propagation for one directly repairable child B in one two-child composite. It does not prove physical multiplicity, exact rate doubling, or equal mechanisms for QTYPM and ENVF.
The native event log records only the first replication of a multi-replication run. Aggregate per-subsystem causation and other child repair policies are not inferred from it.
Failure-induced effects on sibling operation, wrong-level repair/PM, GUI visuals, and cross-engine parity require separate evidence.
